title: Approved dependency register and intake decisions
description: Register of approved direct dependencies with version range, purpose, owner, license, maintainer health, risk rating and approval record; plus intake decisions for each new or changed dependency including transitive additions.

title: Lockfile and pinning verification
description: Per-build verification that NuGet (packages.lock.json in locked mode) and npm (package-lock.json with npm ci) restores used committed lockfiles with content hashes, that CI actions are pinned to commit SHAs, and that container base images are pinned by digest.

title: Release SBOM
description: SBOM for each release artifact in SPDX or CycloneDX, generated in the build from resolved dependencies, meeting the CISA 2026 SBOM minimum elements, covering transitive, runtime and browser components, signed and attached to the release.
signing: Sigstore or equivalent attestation over the SBOM (proposed)
notes: 2026-11-25 refinement-agent: NTIA minimum elements replaced by CISA 2026 SBOM minimum elements.

title: VEX statements for component vulnerabilities
description: Machine-readable VEX statements per release stating, for each vulnerability reported against an included component, whether the product is affected, not affected (with justification), fixed or under investigation.

title: Build provenance attestations
description: SLSA-format build provenance generated by a hosted build service for each released artifact, recording source repository, commit, builder identity, workflow and inputs, verifiable with public tooling.
producer: GitHub Actions artifact attestations (configured in Praxis, Limen and Strata release workflows; no product release exists)
format: in-toto SLSA provenance in Sigstore bundle
signing: Sigstore keyless signing via GitHub OIDC
notes: Observed in workflow definitions: praxis@12bf9951 .github/workflows/native-release.yml (actions/attest-build-provenance), limen@743cdb9b .github/workflows/publish.yml (attests and verifies with gh attestation verify), strata@c6a384ec .github/workflows/release.yml. Workflow runs were not inspected.

title: Deployment-time signature and provenance verification log
description: Per-deployment record that each artifact's signature and provenance were verified against expected repository, workflow and builder before deployment, with the policy version and result.

title: Malicious package and registry protection results
description: Results of malicious-package checks (known-malicious advisories, typosquat and dependency-confusion detection, install-script review), package source mapping configuration and private feed settings.
format: JSON report plus NuGet.config and .npmrc snapshots

title: License compliance report
description: Per-release inventory of component licenses (SPDX identifiers), policy evaluation against allowed, review-required and prohibited lists, attribution notices produced, and exceptions.

title: OpenSSF Scorecard results for dependencies and own repositories
description: Scorecard results for critical dependencies and for Echelon's own repositories, with thresholds, exceptions and trend.
